name: Drug Clearance Rate from Body Weight (Parametric)
description: Drug clearance rate CL is parametrically computed from patient body weight: CL = k × BW^0.75 (allometric scaling). Body weight uncertainty propagates through this formula to clearance uncertainty.

elements.name: Patient Body Weight
elements.description: ICU patient body weight for allometric dose scaling.

uncertainty.source: PhysioNet MIMIC-IV: ICU patient body weight distribution

elements.name: Maximum Clearance Rate
elements.description: Vancomycin therapeutic window: maximum clearance for effective concentration

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(BW) = F·BW + f; F ≈ 0.048×0.75×BW_nom^(−0.25), f = 0.048×BW_nom^0.75(1−0.75) — linearised allometric UPR
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: clearance CZ is affine image of body weight CZ through linearised allometric scaling formula.
